note: TOKEN RETENTION 0.90/0.35, successor to the egw5wq->57zxgz arm, with ONE change: the keep probabilities. WHY, from the epoch-40 check on 2026-11-03: that arm did not underfit and did not overfit -- it CONVERGED SHORT. Both pools went flat together between epoch 30 and 40. In-sample 738-interface mean DockQ 0.5558 (ep30) -> 0.5545 (ep40) against shipped 0.5474, so +0.0084 then +0.0071: it peaked and drifted back. Held-out valfull 0.5859 (ep30) -> 0.5871 (ep35) -> 0.5868 (ep40) against shipped 0.5831, a +0.0037 gain sitting inside a 0.0044 paired s.e. and never approaching the +0.009 significance bar. Held-out frac_acc was pinned at EXACTLY 0.7500 (69/92) for ten consecutive evals. Meanwhile the weights kept travelling: ||W-W0||^2 rose monotonically 2848 (ep28) -> 3220 (ep40), +13%, and the mean gradient norm rose 68% off its ep22 floor (0.783 -> 1.318) with the growth concentrated in the tail (max 2.67 -> 8.50, top-decile share of total gradient 22.7% -> 33.9%). So the head was still moving while neither eval metric did: a flat valley, not a capacity wall. CORRECTING THE EARLIER READ, which this note previously carried and which was wrong: the claim that egw5wq 'underfits' rested on in-sample 0.5451 at epoch 20 and a paired s.e. of ~0.010. In-sample crossed ABOVE shipped at ~epoch 23 and reached +0.0084 by epoch 30, and the paired s.e. is 0.0044, not 0.010. The underfitting diagnosis is RETRACTED; convergence-short replaces it. WHAT THAT ARGUES FOR: 0.414 of tokens gives the head too little of each interface to sharpen the TOP of the ranking, which is the only region selection reads, and the arm proved it can reach a stable optimum there in ~30 epochs. This raises retention to 0.578 of tokens = 0.334 of the original pair work, 1.95x the 0.70/0.20 arm and ~94% of ffj8m4's fixed crop (0.598/0.357), so expect ~45-50 min/epoch and ~25-27 h for 30 epochs with evals. The reference point it must beat is the GT-crop arm o2qczq, which at 16.9% train-PAE descent over 32 epochs transferred only +0.0058 held-out -- statistically the same place 0.70/0.20 landed, reached from the opposite direction. Memory is unchanged because peak is bounded by --ckpt-token-threshold 855, not by mean tokens. L2-SP IS REMOVED ENTIRELY rather than raised: nothing here says the arm was over-free, its gradient was ~0.1% of the median task gradient at this weight travel (section 17: 1e-4 and below are effectively off), and removing it leaves TOKEN RETENTION as the only difference from egw5wq. Eval cadence is egw5wq's, unchanged: uncropped valfull every 5 epochs, uncropped 738-interface training pool every 10. MECHANISM, inherited from egw5wq unchanged except the keep probabilities: BIASED TOKEN DROPOUT 0.90/0.35 (egw5wq used 0.70/0.20) + PAIR DROPOUT 0.25, NO L2-SP, fresh 60-epoch arm from the pretrained head. ONE CHANGE FROM ffj8m4, the arm it must beat: the union mask stops being a FIXED crop and becomes a PRIOR on a fresh draw each epoch -- a token inside the union survives with p=0.90, outside with p=0.35, drawn once per structure per epoch. WHY: ffj8m4 trains on one fixed 59.8% of tokens, which is memorisable, and never shows the head the periphery -- which is why o2qczq scored 0.6305 cropped and 0.5387 uncropped, below shipped 0.5474. A varying subset cannot be memorised and periphery tokens appear 35% of the time, so uncropped inference stops being a regime the head has never seen. AND IT IS FASTER: a dropped token loses its ROW AND COLUMN from z rather than being zeroed, so 0.578 of tokens is 0.334 of the original pair work against ffj8m4 0.598/0.357. TWO INVARIANTS: one draw per structure per EPOCH shared by all 50 poses, because the relative loss grades the gaps between them and per-epoch is exactly per-step under cross-seed; and every rank draws the SAME mask, seeded sha256(--seed, epoch, pdb) -- hash() is salted per process and would have given each rank a different draw. THE COST ACCEPTED: ipTM pools over the scored pair and normalises by a d0 from its token count, so a varying subset varies the achievable score while the label stays full-structure, and d0 enters nonlinearly so it does not cancel under mean-centring. ffj8m4 already carries that at a fixed 62% of each scored chain; this varies it ~62-83%. EVAL IS ALWAYS UNCROPPED: valfull every 5 epochs, the 738 winnable training interfaces every 10, both uncropped, because a cropped reading carries forced ground-truth contacts and is never a deployment number.
